templates.title: Email templates
templates.description: Every email the platform sends, in one branded layout. Edit the wording, preview it with sample data and reset to the default at any time.

layout.title: Shared layout
layout.description: The frame around every email: an optional header image and a footer line such as your postal address.
layout.headerImageHelp: An https image shown above the brand name. Leave empty to show the brand name only.
layout.footerHelp: Shown under every email. Global tokens such as {{examples}} work here.

editor.subject: Subject
editor.preheaderHelp: The preview line some inboxes show next to the subject.
editor.bodyHelp: Blank lines start a new paragraph. Use # for a heading, - for a list, > for a callout, **bold**, [label](address) for links and !button Label|address for a button.
editor.resetDescription: The built-in wording comes back. Your edits stay in the version history.
editor.noProviderTitle: No email provider is set up
editor.noProviderBody: Set up a provider first, then send a test.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Click a token to insert it at the cursor. Unknown tokens are rejected when you save.

preview.title: Preview
preview.error: The preview needs a valid template: {{message}}

history.title: Version history
history.empty: No saved versions yet. The first save creates one.

audiences.title: Audiences
audiences.description: Saved groups of people to write to. Rules pick users by role, team, project, sign-in domain or inactivity, and you can add extra addresses by hand.

empty.title: No audiences yet
empty.description: Create a group such as all admins or everyone inactive for 90 days, then send it a message.

dialog.name: Name
dialog.domainsHelp: One per line, for example example.com.
dialog.inactiveHelp: Narrows the selection, or selects everyone inactive that long when nothing else is chosen.
dialog.extraHelp: One per line. Added even if they are not users.
dialog.noneChosen: Pick at least one rule to see who is included.

audiences.deleteDescription: Past messages keep their history. This only removes the saved rules.

suppressions.title: Opt-out list
suppressions.description: People here are skipped by announcements. Security and account emails always arrive.
suppressions.added: Address added to the opt-out list.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Write to an audience or to chosen people. Messages go out in the saved layout with a one-click unsubscribe link, rate limited, and every send is in the history.

noProvider.title: Email is not set up
noProvider.body: Messages need an email provider. Set one up, send a test, then come back.

composer.title: New message
composer.subject: Subject
composer.bodyHelp: Tokens such as {{example}} are filled in per person.

confirm.title: Send this message?
confirm.summary: This will email {{deliverable}} people, {{suppressed}} are suppressed.

history.title: History

empty.title: No messages yet
empty.description: Sent and scheduled messages show up here with delivery counts.

history.cancelDescription: People who were not reached yet will not get it.
